notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
I made an update to the game, and here is the list of changes.

[list]
    [*]Double tapping left/right to dash can now be toggled on or off.  It defaults to ON for previous players and OFF for new players.
    [*]A Mac version has been added.
    [*]The text for the dash powerup now mentions the dash key set in the control settings.
    [*]Invulnerability time has been reduced for all enemies, including bosses.
    [*]The first boss has 2 less health, a slightly lower starting speed, but a much higher max speed.
    [*]A save point has been added near the first powerup.
    [*]The main music loop has been extended and the final boss music has been changed.
[/list]
